The Rondache is a shield requiring 80 Defence to wield. It is a magically-enhanced icyene artefact,[1] and is a potential reward from completion of The Fractured Archive, the fourth raid. The Rondache boasts the joint highest strength bonus of any shield slot equipment, equal to the avernic defender. Whilst it has no melee accuracy bonuses, it has higher defence bonuses than the Avernic defender, especially in Ranged defence at +55 which is similar to a blessed spirit shield.
